inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A single continuous ten-second cinematic live-action martial-arts fight between EXACTLY the two original adult male actors in Picture 1. Scorpion in yellow and black starts LEFT; Sub-Zero in blue and black starts RIGHT. Preserve the same masks, hoods, human faces and proportions, cloth costumes, secured waist accessories and sunlit stone courtyard. Both full bodies and boots stay visible in the same medium-wide side view; restrained tracking follows the physical retreat. The courtyard stays geographically stable.

FAST COMPACT COMBINATIONS with immediate counters at normal fighting speed. Every punch accelerates, contacts and retracts immediately; the receiver continues recoiling AFTER the limb has separated. Every kick immediately folds back at the knee and the boot lands. The counterattack starts during the opponent's retraction. Neither waits for a pose to finish.

Opening: Sub-Zero snaps a RIGHT straight into Scorpion's raised LEFT forearm block, instantly retracts and follows with a short LEFT body hook. Scorpion's abdomen folds, his hips shift back and his rear boot takes a catching step. During that recovery Scorpion snaps a LEFT jab toward Sub-Zero's guard and a RIGHT cross that knocks the blue fighter's shoulders back. Arms return at once; blocking moves the guard, body contact moves the torso and forces steps.

Middle: Scorpion immediately snaps one LEFT front kick into Sub-Zero's torso, folds the knee and lands his boot at once. Sub-Zero takes TWO hurried catching steps from the impact. Scorpion pursues the retreat with his guard up. Sub-Zero plants, pivots his LEFT support foot and whips a short RIGHT low kick into the outside of Scorpion's forward thigh. The yellow knee yields and the other boot catches his weight. Sub-Zero retracts and lands immediately. Scorpion answers with a compact RIGHT straight as Sub-Zero recovers. The exchange flows through attacks, blocks, separation, recoil and pursuit without idle bouncing or returning to the opening pose.

Closing reversal in the last two seconds: Sub-Zero catches his footing and brings both palms toward Scorpion's advancing chest. A SHORT narrow blue-white ice blast leaves ONLY Sub-Zero's palms, crosses the gap and strikes Scorpion's upper torso. Frost forms ON Scorpion's existing clothing at that contact, spreads across that same torso and down his legs, and thickens into a translucent shell attached to his body. His advancing boot becomes fixed to the stone and his movement stops in the struck posture. Sub-Zero withdraws his hands into guard. End with the same two physical actors, Scorpion immobilized and Sub-Zero still alert. All ice is attached to Scorpion or a small connected patch under his boots; no separate ice people, statues, clones or detached human silhouettes. The blast ends after contact; cold vapor dissipates around that attached shell.

Force comes from hips and planted feet. Scorpion presses aggressively; Sub-Zero reads, yields under impact and reverses initiative with his own ice power. Keep eyes engaged. Preserve realistic skin, cloth and costume detail. No held kicks, fists parked on bodies, rigid sliding feet, floating boots, drunken swaying, long swords, new weapons, fire, extra people, cuts, orbit, flashes, camera shake or text.

overall_soundscape: Quick synchronized dry impacts, distinct footfalls on stone, cloth movement and quiet courtyard wind. A short cold hiss and ice crackle only during the closing ice blast. No speech, vocalizations, grunts or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.
